an8.21:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.21:1.3: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ dhārethāti.
an8.21:1.5: idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an8.21:2.1: athakho aññataro bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena uggassa gahapatino vesālikassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.21:2.2: athakho uggo gahapati vesāliko yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ so bhikkhu etadavoca
an8.21:3.1: aṭṭhahi kho tvaṃ gahapati acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākato
an8.21:3.2: katame te gahapati aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā yehi tvaṃ samannāgato bhagavatā byākatoti.
an8.21:3.4: katamehi ahaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākato
an8.21:3.5: api ca bhante yeme aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā saṃvijjanti
an8.21:3.6: te suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti.
an8.21:3.7: evaṃ gahapatīti kho so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino vesālikassa paccassosi.
an8.21:3.9: yadāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ dūratova addasaṃ
an8.21:3.10: saha dassaneneva me bhante bhagavato cittaṃ pasīdi
an8.21:3.11: ayaṃ kho me bhante paṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:4.1: so kho ahaṃ bhante pasannacitto bhagavantaṃ payirupāsiṃ
an8.21:4.2: tassa me bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyathīdaṃ
an8.21:4.3: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi
an8.21:4.4: yadā maṃ bhagavā aññāsi kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi
an8.21:4.6: seyyathāpi nāma suddhavatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma deva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya
an8.21:4.7: evameva kho me tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
an8.21:4.9: so kho ahaṃ bhante diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane
an8.21:4.10: tattheva buddhañca dhammañca saṅghañca saraṇaṃ agamāsiṃ brahmacariyapañcamāni ca sikkhāpadāni samādayiṃ
an8.21:4.11: ayaṃ kho me bhante dutiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:5.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhante catasso komāriyo pajāpatiyo ahesuṃ
an8.21:5.2: athakhvāhaṃ bhante yena tā pajāpatiyo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā tā pajāpatiyo etadavocaṃ
an8.21:5.3: mayā kho bhaginiyo brahmacariyapañcamāni sikkhāpadāni samādinnāni
an8.21:5.4: yā icchati sā imeva bhoge bhuñjatu puññāni ca karotu sakāni vā ñātikulāni gacchatu
an8.21:5.5: hoti vā pana purisādhippāyo kassa vo dammīti
an8.21:5.6: evaṃ vutte sā bhante jeṭṭhā pajāpati maṃ etadavoca
an8.21:5.8: athakho ahaṃ bhante taṃ purisaṃ pakkosāpetvā vāmena hatthena pajāpatiṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena bhiṅgāraṃ gahetvā tassa purisassa oṇojesiṃ
an8.21:5.9: komāriṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante dānaṃ pariccajanto nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattaṃ
an8.21:5.10: ayaṃ kho me bhante tatiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:6.1: saṃvijjanti kho pana me bhante kule bhogā
an8.21:6.2: te ca kho appaṭivibhattā sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi
an8.21:6.3: ayaṃ kho me bhante catuttho acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:7.1: yaṃ kho panāhaṃ bhante bhikkhuṃ payirupāsāmi
an8.21:7.3: ayaṃ kho me bhante pañcamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:8.1: so ce me āyasmā dhammaṃ desesi
an8.21:8.3: no ce me āyasmā dhammaṃ desesi ahamassa dhammaṃ desemi
an8.21:8.4: ayaṃ kho me bhante chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:9.1: anacchariyaṃ kho pana maṃ bhante devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti
an8.21:9.3: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante tā devatā evaṃ vadāmi
an8.21:9.4: vadeyyātha vā evaṃ kho tumhe devate no vā vadeyyātha athakho svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammoti
an8.21:9.5: na kho panāhaṃ bhante abhijānāmi tatonidānaṃ cittassa uṇṇanti
an8.21:9.6: maṃ vā devatā upasaṅkamanti ahaṃ vā devatāhi saddhiṃ sallapāmi
an8.21:9.7: ayaṃ kho me bhante sattamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:10.1: yānimāni bhante bhagavatā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni nāhaṃ tesaṃ kiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmi
an8.21:10.2: ayaṃ kho me bhante aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo saṃvijjati.
an8.21:11.1: ime kho bhante aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā saṃvijjanti
an8.21:11.3: katamehi cāhaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākatoti.
an8.21:12.1: athakho so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino vesālikassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi
an8.21:12.2: athakho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi
an8.21:12.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu yāvatako ahosi uggena gahapatinā vesālikena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
an8.21:13.2: yathātaṃ uggo gahapati vesāliko sammā byākaramāno byākareyya imeheva kho bhikkhu aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgato uggo gahapati vesāliko mayā byākato
an8.21:13.3: imehi ca pana bhikkhu aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ dhārethāti. 22
